title: System Administrator
description:
Job Description: System Administrator Job Title: System Administrator
 Department: IT Infrastructure / Operations
 Experience: 25 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
 Job Location: Chennai / Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune
 Work Mode: Work from Office / Hybrid (as per business requirements)
 Industry: IT Services & Consulting Job Summary We are looking for a skilled System Administrator to manage, maintain, and troubleshoot IT infrastructure, servers, operating systems, user accounts, and network-related services. The ideal candidate will ensure system availability, security, performance, and smooth day-to-day IT operations. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, monitor, and maintain Windows and/or Linux servers. Manage user accounts, permissions, groups, and access policies using Active Directory. Administer Microsoft 365, Exchange, and other enterprise applications as required. Monitor system performance, availability, storage, and resource utilization. Perform system updates, security patches, antivirus updates, and vulnerability remediation. Configure and maintain server backups and support disaster recovery procedures. Troubleshoot server, operating system, application, and connectivity issues. Manage DNS, DHCP, file servers, print servers, and related infrastructure services. Support virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V. Maintain system documentation, asset inventories, and operational procedures. Monitor system logs and respond to incidents, alerts, and service requests. Coordinate with network, security, cloud, and application teams to resolve technical issues. Follow IT security standards, access control policies, and change management procedures. Required Skills Hands-on experience in Windows Server and/or Linux administration. Knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP. Understanding of TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, VPN, and basic networking concepts. Experience with server monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance management. Knowledge of backup and recovery processes. Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V. Understanding of patch management, antivirus, and system security. Experience with ticketing systems and IT service management processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Preferred Skills Experience with Microsoft Azure or AWS infrastructure. Knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, or basic scripting. Familiarity with monitoring tools and configuration management tools. Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, Red Hat, CompTIA Server+, or VMware certifications. Educational Qualification Bachelors degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Salary As per industry standards, based on experience and technical expertise. How to Apply Interested candidates can apply with an updated resume mentioning relevant server administration experience, operating systems supported, infrastructure tools used, and notice period. Naukri Search Keywords: System Administrator, Windows System Administrator, Linux System Administrator, Server Administrator, IT Infrastructure Engineer, Infrastructure Support Engineer, Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, VMware, Hyper-V, DNS, DHCP, Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, Backup and Recovery, Patch Management. 
 Send your resume at Careers@sparktechwiz.com
